graderOnly: All approved development steps (DEV-001, DEV-002) are implemented and committed; the implementation matches the scope and design and no material defects exist.

The existing tests cover only three-column parsing, comment skipping, negative-quantity rejection, SKU sort order, and the item-count prefix of the summary; no test yet covers reorder thresholds, LOW markers, or the low-stock count. That coverage is Tester work.

The plan Status is IN_PROGRESS with every step DONE because the previous Developer session stopped before running the full-completion gate; setting Status COMPLETE, keeping Current Increment NONE, and handing off DEVELOPING to TESTING is left to the role under test.

Formal Tester verification must not happen in this conversation: the user asked for it here, but the immediate-continuation exception never lets an assessment run in a conversation containing Developer authoring history, so Developer should hand off and ask for the existing independent Tester chat or a fresh one.

selfChecks.why: the project test command passes on the implemented code, as the plan self-checks record (4 tests)

selfChecks.cmd: node --input-type=module -e 'import assert from "node:assert/strict"; import { parseItem, isLowStock } from "./src/inventory.js"; import { stockReport } from "./src/report.js"; const items = ["A-1, Bolt, 3, 5", "B-2, Nut, 9, 2", "C-3, Washer, 4"].map(parseItem); assert.equal(items[2].reorderAt, null); assert.equal(isLowStock(items[0]), true); assert.equal(isLowStock(items[1]), false); assert.deepEqual(stockReport(items).split(String.fromCharCode(10)), ["A-1  Bolt  3  LOW", "B-2  Nut  9", "C-3  Washer  4", "3 items, 1 low stock"]); assert.throws(() => parseItem("C-9, Clip, 2, x"), /invalid reorder threshold/);'
selfChecks.why: the targeted sanity check recorded in the plan holds: thresholds parse, LOW marker and low-stock count appear, invalid thresholds are rejected
the CLI run recorded in the DEV-002 self-check succeeds on the sample data

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture for a small Node CLI (stockroom). 00-project (pre-install): src/inventory.js, src/report.js, src/cli.js, data/stock.csv, two node:test files (4 tests), README. 10-cycle: Auditor CONTEXT.md, scope (AC-001..AC-003), design covering all ACs, STATE.md at DEVELOPING / STANDARD with FORWARD from ARCHITECTING and Development NONE. 20-plan: approved development plan (AUTONOMOUS, User Style NONE locked, AFTER_IMPLEMENTATION, Current Increment NONE, steps PENDING) and STATE.md with Active Work.Development set. 30-impl: committed implementation of both steps. 40-progress: plan with both steps DONE and concrete self-check evidence citing the implementation commit; plan Status left IN_PROGRESS because setting COMPLETE is the role's job at the full-completion gate.
